<script type="text/javascript">
(function(){
  function latestRouteSearchEvent(){
    var dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
    for(var index = dataLayer.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1){
      var entry = dataLayer[index];
      if(entry && entry.event === 'route_search'){
        return entry;
      }
    }
    return {};
  }

  if(!window.mixpanel || typeof window.mixpanel.track !== 'function'){
    return;
  }

  var eventData = latestRouteSearchEvent();
  window.mixpanel.track('route_search', {
    from: eventData.from || '',
    to: eventData.to || '',
    day_type: eventData.day_type || '',
    results_count: Number(eventData.results_count || 0),
    no_results: Boolean(eventData.no_results)
  });
})();
</script>
